description: Canonical Word placeholders for engagement documentation templates. Use the exact `token` string in the .docx body. Fill Word supplies values from the engagement, client, fiscal year, mapping list date, and `settings.INVOICE_LETTERHEAD` where noted.

tokens.notes: List date from the documentation mapping when Fill Word is used (d.m.y, e.g. 1.7.2025); otherwise today’s local date.
Same value as {{LETTER_DATE}} — use in management-representation / MR templates.
Legal / display client name.
Short place under client name: `Client.area` if set, else first segment of `city_state_pincode` before a comma, else full `city_state_pincode`.
Client address line 1
Client address line 2
Client address line 3
Fiscal year code (e.g. FY26).
Calendar year of the fiscal year `end_date` (e.g. 2026 for year ended 31 March 2026).
Fiscal year end in words: `31 March 2026` from `FiscalYear.end_date`.
Day and month only: `31 March` (no year).
Literal phrase: `year ended 31 March 2026` when end date exists; empty otherwise.
Firm PAN / GST line from letterhead.
Engagement audit fee in figures when set.
Reserved for fee in words (not populated yet).
Letterhead `authorised_signatory_name` (firm signatory on invoices — not the client MR signatory).
Reserved for ICAI membership no. (not populated yet).
Engagement service description.
Firm name for “To” block: `INVOICE_LETTERHEAD.firm_name` (title-cased if all caps).
Second line: `firm_subtitle` (e.g. Chartered Accountants).
Office city: `firm_office_city` if set in letterhead, else parsed from last segment of `address_line_1` before 6-digit PIN.
Client `contact_person` (management representation signatory). Extend master data if you need a dedicated director field.
Optional: `INVOICE_LETTERHEAD.management_rep_signatory_designation` for a firm-wide default; empty if unset.
